messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

Keep the person's identity, appearance, expression, scene, and camera unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the person's current action with the one demonstrated in the reference video. Use the reference video only for the action. Keep the person's identity, appearance, expression, scene, and camera unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands on a concrete ledge, first in profile with one hand on her hip, then raises her other hand to touch her hair before turning her back to the camera and looking out toward the water.","camera":"A static, medium full shot at eye level that keeps the woman centered against the background.","clothing":"A short, one-piece romper with a teal and black striped halter top and a white skirt covered in a pink, yellow, and green floral print, paired with flat reddish-brown shoes.","hair_color":"Dark brown to black.","hairstyle":"Dark hair pulled back into a small bun at the back of the head, with a few loose strands at the nape.","identity":"A young woman with a slim build and tanned skin, shown in profile and then from behind.","scene":"An outdoor seaside location on a sunny day, with a calm blue sea, a low stone wall, and a wooden post visible in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The woman now performs the reference motion: standing in profile with one hand on her hip, raising the other hand to touch/adjust her hair, then turning her back to the camera. The seaside scene and static framing remain similar, but her clothing changed from a fully floral romper to a teal-and-black striped halter top with a floral skirt, and her hairstyle changed from two low pigtails to a small bun.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person's current action with the motion reference action while keeping identity, appearance, expression, scene, and camera unchanged.
uncertain: Whether the woman's identity and facial features were preserved exactly.
unexpected_changes: Clothing changed from an all-over floral romper to a teal/black striped halter top with a floral skirt.
Hairstyle changed from two low pigtails to a small bun.
Facial profile and apparent identity became more visible and may differ from the source person.
